## Disposition (M5-1/M5-2 cycle — 2026-06-21)

The raw verdict is `FAIL_HARD` but it is **NOT delta-scoped** — the D1 dead-code
detector ran `knip` over the entire `theokit` monorepo (28966 "unused export"
findings across all packages) and D2 returned 4 symbol-fab findings. Cross-checked
against this slice's diff (commit `f0f8270`):

- **Zero** of the new symbols (`deriveLiveText`, `deriveError`, `foldAgentToolCards`,
  `defaultResolveEnvelope`, `useAgentToolCards`, `AgentToolCard`, `ToolEnvelopeResolver`,
  `coerceObject`, `pushRunning`, `matchResultCard`) appear in the dead-code table.
- **Zero** `src/client/(agent-tool-cards|use-agent-tool-cards|use-agent-stream)` paths
  appear in any finding.
- The 4 D2 findings are all pre-existing false positives unrelated to this slice:
  `virtual:integration:banner` (Vite virtual module), `@theokit/http/runtime/node`
  (published subpath, ambiguous registry response), `@theokit/ui/styles.css` (CSS
  import). None in changed files.

**Slice disposition: CLEAN.** The new exports each have a caller (barrel + hook) and a
test (`tests/unit/agent-stream-derivations.test.ts`, incl. the public-barrel wiring
assertion), so they cannot be dead. The absolute `FAIL_HARD` reflects the untuned
whole-repo `knip` baseline, not this change. Tuning the monorepo `knip` config is
out of scope for M5 and tracked separately.
